original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚三角洲州一名女子涉嫌伪造绑架以勒索兄弟1500万奈拉
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚三角洲州警方逮捕一名54岁女子，其被指伪造自己被绑架，以向其弟弟勒索1500万奈拉。该女子据称声称遭数名男子劫持至灌木丛，并被索要赎金。警方发言人表示，案件于2026年10月23日在Ogwashi-Uku分区警察总部报案，反绑架小组已展开调查。目前该案为单一来源报道，相关指控尚未经法院证实。

location.raw_text: Delta State, Ogwashi-Uku Divisional Police Headquarters, Obu-Luku, Aniocha South Local Government Area

key_facts.fact: 三角洲州警方逮捕一名54岁女子，其被指伪造绑架勒索弟弟1500万奈拉
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Delta State Police Command has arrested a 54-year-old woman for allegedly faking her own kidnapping to extort N15m from her younger brother.

key_facts.fact: 该女子据称声称被数名男子劫持至灌木丛并遭索要赎金
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The woman reportedly claimed that she had been abducted and taken to the bush by some men, who demanded N15m ransom for her release.

key_facts.fact: 案件于2026年10月23日在Ogwashi-Uku分区警察总部报案
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the case was reported at the Ogwashi-Uku Divisional Police Headquarters on October 23, 2026

key_facts.fact: 警察局长指示Obu-Luku反绑架小组展开调查
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: prompting the Commissioner of Police to direct the Anti-Kidnapping Unit in Obu-Luku, Aniocha South Local Government Area, to investigate

uncertainties: 伪造绑架的指控尚未经法院证实，仅为警方指控
目前仅单一来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
女子是否确实实施伪造绑架行为有待核实
